question: How did the contributions of others lead to this illumination being brought forth by the author?
premises: Others did something for the author.
This work or illumination came afterward.
The author brought it to light.
inference: Prompted by what others did, the author illumined this work.
uncertainties: The exact nature of what others did is unspecified.
plain_english: They did something for me; then this was illumined by me.
